title: Sticky Gochujang Chicken Thighs
summary: Sweet-spicy glazed chicken that caramelizes in the oven; weeknight-easy and great over rice.
difficulty_reason: One bowl for the sauce and one sheet pan; nothing fussy.
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F and line a sheet pan with foil.
Whisk the gochujang, honey, soy sauce, garlic and sesame oil in a large bowl.
Pat the chicken dry, season with salt, and toss it in two-thirds of the glaze.
Spread the chicken on the pan and roast for 20 minutes.
Brush with the rest of the glaze and roast 5 to 8 minutes more, until sticky and charred at the edges.
Rest 5 minutes, then top with scallions and sesame seeds and serve over rice.
tips: Use thighs, not breasts: they stay juicy under the high heat.
missing: The video didn't give amounts for the soy sauce or sesame oil.
